user_query: Identify this protein sequence and provide a concise description of its function, sequence-derived properties, catalytic activity, regulation, localization, and relevant annotations. Distinguish direct sequence-derived observations from homolog-based annotations.

warnings: Sequence-derived estimates assume an unmodified protein and do not account for processing, PTMs, bound ligands, or oligomers.

function: GTP-binding protein with GTPase activity (PubMed:39809765). The level of let-60 controls the switch between vulval and hypodermal cell fates during C.elegans vulval induction (PubMed:20230814, PubMed:2123303, PubMed:2257629, PubMed:23103556, PubMed:24929033, PubMed:28135265, PubMed:32053105). May stimulate the guanine nucleotide exchange factor (GEF) activity of rap-1 (PubMed:10608844). May induce nuclear condensation (PubMed:23103556).
